page.notes: Uncertain readings: the third Greek word, printed as ꝏαἰρεσις, is read as προαίρεσις and marked [?]. The Greek letters are approximate in the scan. Long s is printed as f-like forms in "femisse", "effet", "posse" and "justitiæ", and is rendered as plain s. The printed spellings "effet" and "exsemisse" are kept as they appear. The left margin shows fragments of the neighbouring page, which are excluded. The right-margin notes were placed beside the lines where they stand. The line "immine-re:at" and "intelligi-mus:" keep their printed hyphens.
